/usr/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import pathlib
import subprocess
import tempfile

paths = ['config.py', 'app.py', 'stats.py', 'formatting.py', 'tests/test_report.py']
probe = '''from app import report
cases = [
    (\"empty/default\", [], {}),
    (\"empty/None\", [], {\"detailed\": None}),
    (\"empty/plain\", [], {\"detailed\": False}),
    (\"empty/detailed\", [], {\"detailed\": True}),
    (\"populated/default\", [2, 4], {}),
    (\"populated/plain\", [2, 4], {\"detailed\": False}),
    (\"populated/detailed\", [2, 4], {\"detailed\": True}),
    (\"fractional/default\", [1, 2], {}),
    (\"singleton/default\", [-3], {}),
]
for label, values, kwargs in cases:
    try:
        print(f\"{label}: {report(values, **kwargs)"'!r}")
    except Exception as error:
        print(f"{label}: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
'"'''
for label, revision in [('base HEAD', 'HEAD:'), ('candidate index', ':')]:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='batch-report-review-') as directory:
        for name in paths:
            source = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', revision + name])
            target = pathlib.Path(directory, name)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(source)
        print(f'--- {label} ---', flush=True)
        result = subprocess.run(['python3', '-B', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-v'], cwd=directory, capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(result.stdout + result.stderr, end='')
        print(f'unittest exit: {result.returncode}')
        result = subprocess.run(['python3', '-B', '-c', probe], cwd=directory, capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(result.stdout + result.stderr, end='')
        print(f'scenario probe exit: {result.returncode}')
PY"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git show HEAD:app.py
git show HEAD:stats.py
git show HEAD:formatting.py
git show :config.py
git show :stats.py
git status -sb'

arguments.content: P1 review pattern: enabling an existing optional mode by default broadens the reach of inherited boundary failures. In batch-report review of HEAD a21036447ee7843887ddbaff82408db6e044b053 versus staged config.py, DETAILED_REPORT=True makes report([]) and report([], detailed=None) enter stats.summarize's unguarded mean calculation and raise ZeroDivisionError; base default calls returned Items: 0. The explicit detailed=True empty failure already existed, so distinguish that inherited bug from the new default-path regression. All four existing tests pass in both snapshots because they cover empty batches only with detailed=False. Check default/explicit mode combinations across valid empty and populated inputs when changing activation defaults; preserve count-only summaries for empty inputs and add focused empty default/detailed regression coverage.
